executive.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
executive.description: After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises.

executive.title: Zuckerberg says Meta’s enterprise AI opportunity extends beyond agents
executive.description: On the company’s second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta sees a “large enterprise opportunity” spanning AI agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.

executive.title: After shocking quarter, IBM insists that AI isn’t killing the mainframe
executive.description: After IBM's stock crashed last week on warnings of poor mainframe sales, the CEO explained that AI wrecked corporate hardware budget, temporarily.

executive.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
executive.description: A running look — in reverse chronological order — at the bigger tech companies that have announced significant layoffs this year with AI as a stated factor.

executive.title: Lucid Motors’ new CEO cuts 18% of staff to ‘simplify the company’
executive.description: The company is also eliminating a production shift at its Arizona factory to align "production plans with anticipated demand."

executive.title: Robinhood’s note on 10% layoffs shows blaming AI isn’t cutting it
executive.description: Unlike many of his tech industry peers who have cut thousands of jobs citing the need to restructure  to make the most of AI, Robinhood's CEO Vlad Tenev conspicuously made no mention of AI in his note

executive.title: Tech CEOs are apparently suffering from AI psychosis
executive.description: "CEOs are uniquely prone to AI psychosis," Box CEO Aaron Levie opines. Maybe that explains the almost religious belief in AI productivity gains.

executive.title: Intuit to lay off over 3,000 employees to refocus on AI
executive.description: In a memo to employees, CEO Sasan Goodarzi said the layoffs are meant to reduce complexity, simplify the company's corporate structure, and deliver better AI products.

executive.title: Cisco cuts nearly 4,000 jobs to spend more on AI, reports ‘record quarterly revenue’
executive.description: This is Cisco's latest layoff in recent years, while the company's chief executive touts record revenue and growth.

executive.title: Cloudflare says AI made 1,100 jobs obsolete, even as revenue hit a record high
executive.description: Cloudflare announced its first large-scale layoff. CEO Matthew Prince says because of AI efficiency gains, the company doesn't need as many support roles.

funding.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
funding.description: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

funding.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
funding.description: The startup analyzes calls, messages, and CRM data to identify effective sales techniques and turn them into playbooks for AI agents.

funding.title: ServiceNow bets $40 million on Indian banking software specialist to expand its financial services push
funding.description: ServiceNow's investment gives BusinessNext a strategic partner to expand its AI-powered banking software globally.

funding.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
funding.description: There's about to be a big fight to secure access to space.

funding.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
funding.description: Andreessen Horowitz has two partners sitting on the boards of companies that now compete with each other: Ben Horowitz at Databricks and Martin Casado at Fivetran. Nothing too scandalous on

funding.title: Rillet raises $100M Series C at $1B valuation — 2 years after emerging from stealth
funding.description: AI-native account startup Rillet became a unicorn, led by Iconiq, after it doubled its ARR in the past three months, it said.

funding.title: Sachin Bansal’s fintech Navi raises first outside capital with $100M Prosus investment
funding.description: The investment comes amid Navi plans to go public.

layoffs.title: AI was supposed to kill engineering jobs, but new data suggests they’re the most resilient
layoffs.description: While AI dominates the layoff narrative, engineers are actually making up a larger share of new hires, according to SignalFire data.

layoffs.title: As OpenAI files for IPO, Sam Altman’s eye-scanning company is doing layoffs, report says
layoffs.description: Tools for Humanity, Sam Altman's identity verification company, is reportedly struggling to generate revenue and will downsize its staff.

layoffs.title: GM just laid off hundreds of IT workers to hire those with stronger AI skills
layoffs.description: Some of the positions focus on AI-native development, data engineering and analytics, cloud-based engineering, and agent and model development as well as prompt engineering and new AI workflows.

layoffs.title: Truecaller slashes 70 jobs amid declining ad sales
layoffs.description: Truecaller's ad revenue declined by 44%, leading to the layoffs.

layoffs.title: Coinbase to lay off 14% of staff as part of broader restructuring
layoffs.description: The restructuring is aimed at addressing market volatility and increasing the use of AI tools to improve efficiency.

layoffs.title: Meta to cut 10% of jobs, or 8,000 employees, report says
layoffs.description: According to an internal memo, Meta plans to begin its sweeping layoffs on May 20.

layoffs.title: Redwood Materials lays off 10% in restructuring to chase energy storage business
layoffs.description: The company is restructuring some teams to accommodate a booming energy storage business, according to emails viewed by TechCrunch.
